truth: CORE-01, CORE-02, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. PLATFORM-00 is ACTIVE incomplete; DAW-00 is PRESERVED incomplete; OPS-04 is dependency-ready.

PLATFORM-00A environment/application roots is implemented on mergeable draft PR #29. PLATFORM-00B process identity + fail-closed per-profile single-instance lease is implemented on mergeable draft PR #36 head 2c60018d6e000768336322db40e134079a7b7a6c.

The published PLATFORM-00B instance.py blob cd2648cee1aea6cdcff41d2bfccd6f9f9a84d1b9 is byte-identical to the repaired implementation that passed a 21-case local adversarial harness. Hosted exact-head execution for PR #36 is UNOBSERVED.

Global reselection chose PLATFORM-00C because the canonical support matrix still distinguishes policy in prose while product code did not yet mechanically separate configured targets from exact acceptance evidence.
PLATFORM-00C is the only active increment. It is a pure support policy/evidence projection and performs no build, package, signing, OS probe, plugin hosting or acceptance execution.

The default architecture policy preserves six required CORE peer targets: macOS arm64/x86_64, Windows x86_64/arm64, Linux x86_64/arm64. Extended reach remains separate and cannot substitute for any CORE target.
Target declaration never implies acceptance. Without exact evidence a CORE target is UNVERIFIED and remains a customer-mode blocker.

ACCEPTED and LEGACY_ACCEPTED satisfy the exact target contract; LEGACY_ACCEPTED requires an explicit upstream limitation. KNOWN_BREAK requires an exact named reason plus evidence. EXPERIMENTAL remains non-accepted.
A CORE target cannot be silently downgraded to EXTENDED. Evidence for a target outside the envelope and duplicate/conflicting evidence for one target are rejected.
OS/architecture aliases reuse PLATFORM-00A normalization. Scope tags can make exact distro/package/hardware subtargets, but tag ordering and duplication do not change identity.
OS version policy is exact target identity data only; no OS marketing/version name automatically raises or lowers the support floor.

The exact pre-publication support module passed 20 focused adversarial cases. Published support.py blob verification and repository tests are part of the active increment evidence; full hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
No named DAW adapter, business/communications workflow, app installer, plugin host or platform package is included in PLATFORM-00C.
Windows and Linux remain peer consumer platforms with macOS. Historical platform or DAW maturity has zero scheduling priority.
